rule: Row appears in both workbook sheets (overlapping dates); one verified-identical copy is kept.
Invoice number starts with 'C' (cancellation/return). Tracked separately, never netted into revenue.
Not a 'C' invoice but quantity <= 0 (stock write-offs, damages, adjustments). Tracked separately.
Unit price <= 0 (free items, adjustments, 'bad debt' entries).
Non-merchandise stock code (postage, fees, manual/accounting lines, test products).
Sale fully cancelled the same day by the same customer (same stock code and quantity). Treated as an order correction, not demand.
Row belongs to a last calendar day that is only partly recorded.
Used for the daily gross revenue target.
